title: "Scaled photo selector"

**Status: Documented and demonstrated**

This status is based on the supplied project documentation and example XLSForms. It is not a formal validation claim.
:::

## Purpose

Capture a photograph with scale and measurement context. The operator aligns an on-screen calibrated HUD ruler with a physical ruler, captures the original photo, optionally selects grid cells, and returns both the unmodified original and an annotated copy.

In the dashboard this capability is grouped with image redaction under:

```text
Image annotation and redaction
```

Use scaled photo when the original image should be preserved. Use image redaction when sensitive regions should be removed before export.

## Capability IDs

- `scaled_photo.capture`

## Requirements

- Camera or image-selection access.

## Supported XLSForm calls

**From `example_odk_scaled_photo.capture.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='scaled_photo.capture',input_ruler_length_mm='50',input_hud_scale_ratio='1',input_capture_orientation='portrait',input_grid_rows='10',input_grid_columns='10',input_show_grid='true',return_mode='flat')
```

## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Input | Description |
|---|---|
| `input_ruler_length_mm` | Length of the on-screen HUD ruler. |
| `input_hud_scale_ratio` | Real-world ruler multiplier, e.g. a 50 mm HUD labelled as a 100 mm physical ruler at 1:2. |
| `input_capture_orientation` | `portrait` or `landscape`. |
| `input_grid_rows` | Number of overlay rows. |
| `input_grid_columns` | Number of overlay columns. |
| `input_show_grid` | Whether to draw grid lines on the annotated output. |
| `input_macro_mode` | Close-up focus/zoom helper for near subjects. |

## Expected returned fields

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `original_image_uri` | Original captured image attachment. |
| `annotated_image_uri` | Annotated image attachment with selected grid cells. |
| `grid_selection_json` | Selected cell IDs. |
| `grid_selection_hash` | Hash of the selected-cell record. |
| `ruler_length_mm` | HUD ruler length. |
| `ruler_target_length_mm` | Real-world ruler length represented by the HUD. |
| `hud_scale_ratio` | HUD scale ratio used. |
| `hud_display_length_mm` | Displayed HUD length. |
| `calibration_pixels_per_mm` | Derived pixel/mm calibration context. |
| `photo_captured_at` | Capture timestamp. |
| `overlay_completed_at` | Annotation timestamp. |

## Direct MethodMesh use

From a capability card:

- **Test** runs without saving study output;
- **Test and save** writes a normal MethodMesh output package;
- the last-result preview shows returned media thumbnails where image URIs are present.

Saved packages contain one canonical JSON file plus the original and annotated image attachments.
